summary: Move a filesystem item to the OS-specific trash/recycle location.

target.notes: Uses native OS integration without requiring Chromium.

caveats: This is not equivalent to File.Delete/Directory.Delete because trash/recycle behavior is observable and recoverable.
Input path separator semantics are platform-specific.

tests.name: trash file
tests.expected_behavior: moves the item to the platform trash and fulfills on completion

tests.name: trash failure
tests.expected_behavior: rejects when the requested item cannot be trashed
